notes.title: Nominate Farming Fever for the "Sit Back and Relax" Steam Award!
notes.notes:
Farming Fever is a serene blend of farming and culinary creativity that offers a haven of relaxation. Here, the simplicity of rural life meets the satisfaction of customer service, as you harvest, cook, and fulfill orders at your own pace. It's a game where every session is a moment of zen, designed to smooth away the day's stress. 

If you agree, consider nominating us for the "Sit Back and Relax" Steam Award for 2023! 

Thank you again for all your support, and may all your holidays be restful and refreshing.

notes.title: Strongblade is coming to Steam on September 14, 2023
notes.notes:
Soon you can travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.

Strongblade is a vibrant, match-3 puzzle adventure with an irresistible charm. As Sean the Mouse, you'll navigate through a stunning world full of puzzles and obstacles, make friends with lovable animal characters, and outsmart crafty villains.

The game features over 30 distinct mechanics and thousands of levels, each packed with thrilling power-ups and combinations. Beyond just solving puzzles, you'll be exploring new territories, setting up and decorating unique campsites, and unearthing treasure chests filled with coins, power-ups, and boosters.

The excitement doesn't stop there. Strongblade lets you compete in heart-pounding in-game events against players from all over. With each level completed, you help brave Sean on his adventurous journey.

So dive into Strongblade's colorful world today. It's not just a game; it's a thrilling adventure filled with fun, challenges, and delightful surprises around every corner.

notes.title: Farming Fever Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, farmers! We're thrilled to announce the newest update for Farming Fever. From heartwarming dialogues to new achievements to added DLCs, this update is packed with all-new features that are sure to enhance your farming experience. 

[b]Town Dialogues [/b]

Ever wondered what your favorite town characters are up to? We've now added dialogues in the town! This means that you can engage with your town's lively characters and see what they're thinking, how they're feeling, and what they're talking about.

[b]Achievements[/b]

We're introducing a new set of achievements for you to unlock! Test your skills, aim for those milestones, and earn achievements.

[b]Downloadable Content (DLCs)[/b]

Finally, we're excited to unveil new DLCs that will open up new dimensions of Farming Fever gameplay. 

[b]Added Languages[/b]

We've added support for Dutch, Finnish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Swedish, Turkish, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Greek, and Vietnamese languages. Now, even more farmers from around the globe can enjoy Farming Fever in their native language!

Happy farming!

notes.title: Heroes Quest Survival is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Confront unique adversaries like orcs and zombies across various locations. Each monster boasts distinct abilities and tactics to challenge your hero. Beware of their lethal attacks, such as poison, to avoid an untimely demise.

Strengthen your hero by upgrading your skills, choosing between the sword or magic. As you progress through the game, gather valuable experience points to unlock new talents and enhance your character's prowess. Experience the life of a tribal leader from the Stone Age! Hunt, collect resources, trade, scare off wild animals, and search for treasure.
Allocate resources
